sketch_notes: The sketches depict a largely static article-style layout across mobile and desktop: header/title area, long-form text blocks, boxed content/media regions, and footer-like sections. No explicit or strongly implied JavaScript-driven controls are visible in either viewport—there is no hamburger icon, submenu indicator, tabs, accordion affordance, modal trigger, search field, form, pagination/load-more control, sticky treatment cue, or scroll utility. Any interactivity beyond standard links would be speculative from these drawings alone.
